messages.subject: camtrapR "Data Exploration" (data format question)
parts:
Folks - pardon this newbie question, but if anyone could point me in the right direction...I am simply trying to run several of the data exploration functions in the camtrapR package:

activityDensity
activityHistogram
activityRadial

The Camelot record table output (CSV) seems to be throwing errors in "R". The "Species" column exists, although species names are separated by a whitespace ("Genus species").

I was hoping to view the ".rda" files that accompany the "camtrapR" package to see .
It looks like that file is using trigraphs to denote all species (e.g. "PBE").
Is that how all species identifications need to be formatted?

Also, is there any easy and simple way to load ".rda" files to a dataframe to view that anyone could suggest?

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: camtrapR "Data Exploration" (data format question)
parts:
Hi,
have you tried running 

example(activityDensity)   etc.?

It will run all the example code at the bottom of the function help file. If you could share a sample of your camelot output table, we could have a closer look. 
Basically, what you want is something like the sample table which you can load by:

data(recordTableSample)

.rda file can be loaded with load(). See here for an example. But you won't need that when you use data(recordTableSample)
